newsitem.title: USA: Defiance Inc sees FY shr $0.80 to $0.90.
newsitem.headline: Defiance Inc sees FY shr $0.80 to $0.90.

text.p: Defiance Inc said on Wednesday that it expects to post earnings per share of $0.80 to $0.90 for the fiscal year ending June 30, 1997.
In the year ended June 30, 1996, the company reported earnings of $0.24 a share, or $1.6 million, including a $2.6 million charge from the sale of a business it had sold.

"Looking ahead at the rest of the fiscal year, we expect earnings will exceed last year's like quarters, assuming the automotive market and the economy remain reasonably stable," Jerry Cooper, president and chief executive officer, said in a statement.
Defiance said it expects its fourth quarter to be the best of the year, since third quarter earnings will be hurt by a charge of $0.06 or $0.07 a share from termination of a pension plan.

Production start-up issues and training personnel at the company's new Upper Sandusky facility continue to adversely affect margins, though it has seen notable improvement in cycle times and efficiencies by the second quarter's end, Defiance said. The company said it expects full capacity levels at the plant in the fourth quarter.
